answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond and pass a slow, verifiable proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware-backed identity before it can attest. Like a lantern that only lights after saffron is weighed and quartz is cut, identity must be earned, not claimed: creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds plus compute and time, while honest agents reuse one credential across epochs, so Sybils become expensive and detectable when their attestations cluster.
